subject: Vendr fast-path invite + evidence routing
messages:
From: Asha Patel <security@lumenpay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenPay Vendor Onboarding <vendors@lumenpay.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr access + CAIQ items for Redwood Inference

Hi Logan,

We’re kicking off LumenPay’s vendor intake for Redwood Inference. We prefer to ingest inventory through Vendr or Whistic; Vendr is our default for structured CAIQ mapping. Can you confirm the right contact and whether you prefer us to invite an org-admin email or a service account for S3/presigned uploads?

Quick asks to unblock onboarding:
- Add Redwood to our Vendr tenant (org-level invite) OR provide a presigned S3 bucket for evidence upload.
- If you’ll use Vendr, please confirm who will be the portal admin and whether we should expect uploaded SOC 2 artifacts (PDF) and ephemeral evidence (logs).
- Share any internal retention or least-privilege notes we should apply when provisioning access.

We’ll also need at least these artifacts initially: SOC 2 type II (most recent), TLS cert chain statement (if hosted endpoints), and a contact for security questions. Attachments accepted (.pdf, .xlsx manifest).

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful — available 10:30–12:00 PT tomorrow.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Vendor Intake / Security Operations
LumenPay
attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr access + CAIQ items for Redwood Inference

Hi Asha — thanks for the note.

Vendr works best for us. Please invite org: redwood-inference@vendr.invites (this is our portal admin address). We’ll accept the org-level invite and do the evidence upload there. For bulk artifacts (SOC 2 PDF, longer archives), we’ll upload directly into Vendr’s secure file drop; if you prefer presigned S3 we can provide one-time presigned URLs.

Short answers:
- Portal admin (invite): redwood-inference@vendr.invites
- Primary security contact: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Security Programs
- Expected uploads: soc2-report-2026.pdf, config-extracts.zip (if requested), TLS cert chain doc.
- Retention note: please set temp access TTL to 90 days for reviewers; evidence attachments are retained per your default Vendr retention unless we request longer.

I attached a short onboarding manifest template to speed mapping (column guidance for CAIQ/SIG). If you want us to pre-populate any fields on the Vendr side, tell us which CSV fields you accept.

I can do a 15-min sync at 10:30 PT tomorrow — I’ll accept a calendar invite if that works.

—
Logan Wright
Security Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-vendr-onboarding-template.xlsx

Logan / Ben — looping you both in.

Ben: can you pull the SOC 2 PDF (finalized 2026 report) from the secure vault and confirm the file name/sha256 so we can upload the canonical copy to Vendr? We’ll also want the pen-test summary excerpt (redacted) if it’s available.

Logan: I updated the onboarding manifest with a note about our preferred field mapping for CAIQ. Ben, I attached the manifest to this thread to show what the upload should look like.

Action items:
- Ben: attach soc2-report-2026.pdf and pen-test-summary-redacted.pdf to the Vendr upload (or send them to me if you prefer me to do the upload).
- Logan: confirm you’ll accept the org invite to redwood-inference@vendr.invites.

We want to minimize back-and-forth; if Ben can drop artifacts into Vendr today I’ll send confirmation to LumenPay.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security | Redwood Inference
